steps.title: 濕式積層、預製殼片與塑鉸區範圍：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wet lay-up, prefabricated shells and hinge-zone extent: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環向搭接長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hoop overlap length” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐層記錄纖維批號、樹脂配比與混合時間、可使用時間、層數與搭接位置（相鄰層搭接錯開），以照片記錄纖維方向；完成後量測套管厚度並以敲擊檢查是否有空鼓，預製殼片則確認灌漿飽滿。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record fabric batch, resin ratio and mixing time, pot life, ply count and overlap locations ply by ply (staggering adjacent overlaps), photographing fibre direction; afterwards measure laminate thickness and sound for hollow spots, and for prefabricated shells confirm full grouting. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工圖標示每一層的起訖位置與搭接錯開方式，樹脂混合有專人記錄時間；積層完成與灌漿完成各列為停留點，監造確認紀錄與外觀後才可進行面塗或下一段施工。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Shop drawings mark each ply's start and end and the overlap stagger, with a designated person timing resin batches; completed lay-up and completed grouting are hold points, and topcoat or the next zone proceeds only after the inspector checks records and appearance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：搭接長度不足或所有層的搭接集中在同一位置，套管受拉時在搭接處滑脫，形成一條縱向弱線；樹脂超過可使用時間仍繼續塗布，含浸不良的纖維無法共同受力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Short overlaps, or all plies overlapping at the same location, let the jacket slip at the overlap under tension, creating a vertical line of weakness; resin used beyond its pot life fails to saturate the fabric, so fibres do not share load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐層記錄纖維批號、樹脂配比與混合時間、可使用時間、層數與搭接位置（相鄰層搭接錯開），以照片記錄纖維方向；完成後量測套管厚度並以敲擊檢查是否有空鼓，預製殼片則確認灌漿飽滿。
knowledge.textEn: Record fabric batch, resin ratio and mixing time, pot life, ply count and overlap locations ply by ply (staggering adjacent overlaps), photographing fibre direction; afterwards measure laminate thickness and sound for hollow spots, and for prefabricated shells confirm full grouting.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工圖標示每一層的起訖位置與搭接錯開方式，樹脂混合有專人記錄時間；積層完成與灌漿完成各列為停留點，監造確認紀錄與外觀後才可進行面塗或下一段施工。
knowledge.textEn: Shop drawings mark each ply's start and end and the overlap stagger, with a designated person timing resin batches; completed lay-up and completed grouting are hold points, and topcoat or the next zone proceeds only after the inspector checks records and appearance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「濕式積層、預製殼片與塑鉸區範圍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wet lay-up, prefabricated shells and hinge-zone extent"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
碳纖維強度是鋼材的數倍，所以用一層就能取代大量箍筋。
逐層記錄纖維批號、樹脂配比與混合時間、可使用時間、層數與搭接位置（相鄰層搭接錯開），以照片記錄纖維方向。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Carbon fibre is several times stronger than steel, so one ply can replace a large amount of hoop steel.
Record fabric batch, resin ratio and mixing time, pot life, ply count and overlap locations ply by ply (staggering adjacent overlaps), photographing fibre direction.
quiz.explanation: 逐層記錄纖維批號、樹脂配比與混合時間、可使用時間、層數與搭接位置（相鄰層搭接錯開），以照片記錄纖維方向；完成後量測套管厚度並以敲擊檢查是否有空鼓，預製殼片則確認灌漿飽滿。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record fabric batch, resin ratio and mixing time, pot life, ply count and overlap locations ply by ply (staggering adjacent overlaps), photographing fibre direction; afterwards measure laminate thickness and sound for hollow spots, and for prefabricated shells confirm full grouting. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 濕式積層、預製殼片與塑鉸區範圍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wet lay-up, prefabricated shells and hinge-zone extent: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環向搭接長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hoop overlap length” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 搭接長度不足或所有層的搭接集中在同一位置，套管受拉時在搭接處滑脫，形成一條縱向弱線；樹脂超過可使用時間仍繼續塗布，含浸不良的纖維無法共同受力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Short overlaps, or all plies overlapping at the same location, let the jacket slip at the overlap under tension, creating a vertical line of weakness; resin used beyond its pot life fails to saturate the fabric, so fibres do not share load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：包覆範圍至少要涵蓋可能的塑鉸區，例如賓州 I-84 跨越橋在每支柱頂與柱底各取 5 呎塑鉸區。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The wrapped extent must cover the potential hinge zones; on a Pennsylvania I-84 overpass, 5 ft hinge zones were taken at the top and bottom of each column.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要總層數正確，搭接位置與纖維方向並不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the total ply count is right, overlap location and fibre direction do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 搭接長度不足或所有層的搭接集中在同一位置，套管受拉時在搭接處滑脫，形成一條縱向弱線；樹脂超過可使用時間仍繼續塗布，含浸不良的纖維無法共同受力。
knowledge.textEn: Short overlaps, or all plies overlapping at the same location, let the jacket slip at the overlap under tension, creating a vertical line of weakness; resin used beyond its pot life fails to saturate the fabric, so fibres do not share load.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「濕式積層、預製殼片與塑鉸區範圍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wet lay-up, prefabricated shells and hinge-zone extent" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 搭接長度不足或所有層的搭接集中在同一位置，套管受拉時在搭接處滑脫，形成一條縱向弱線；樹脂超過可使用時間仍繼續塗布，含浸不良的纖維無法共同受力。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
纖維套管外觀平整沒有氣泡，就表示黏結良好。
optionsEn: Short overlaps, or all plies overlapping at the same location, let the jacket slip at the overlap under tension, creating a vertical line of weakness.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If the jacket looks smooth with no bubbles, the bond must be good.
quiz.explanation: 搭接長度不足或所有層的搭接集中在同一位置，套管受拉時在搭接處滑脫，形成一條縱向弱線；樹脂超過可使用時間仍繼續塗布，含浸不良的纖維無法共同受力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Short overlaps, or all plies overlapping at the same location, let the jacket slip at the overlap under tension, creating a vertical line of weakness; resin used beyond its pot life fails to saturate the fabric, so fibres do not share load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收」與「大尺寸柱試驗與性能驗證」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance" and "Large-scale column tests and performance validation": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「拉拔試驗與敲擊檢查」如何影響橋墩纖維複材耐震補強的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pull-off and sounding tests” governs force, deformation or durability in “FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 套管施工品質無法從外觀判斷，必須以試驗確認：拉拔試驗把圓形拉拔頭黏在硬化後的積層上、切穿至混凝土後垂直拉起，破壞面應在混凝土內，表示黏結強於基材；敲擊或紅外線熱影像可找出積層與混凝土之間的空鼓與脫層；見證試片則與現場同條件製作，送驗拉伸強度與彈性模數。這些結果與設計值比較，決定接受、修補或重做。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「拉拔試驗與敲擊檢查」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jacket quality cannot be judged by appearance and must be confirmed by tests: in a pull-off test a circular dolly is bonded to the cured laminate, cored through to the concrete and pulled perpendicular, and the failure surface should lie in the concrete, showing the bond is stronger than the substrate; tapping or infrared thermography finds voids and delaminations between laminate and concrete; witness panels made under site conditions are tested for tensile strength and modulus. Results are compared with design values to decide acceptance, repair or rework. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pull-off and sounding tests” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：拉拔強度 σ = F/A。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Pull-off strength σ = F/A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「纖維套管外觀平整沒有氣泡，就表示黏結良好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the jacket looks smooth with no bubbles, the bond must be good." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「拉拔試驗與敲擊檢查」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pull-off and sounding tests”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收
knowledge.titleEn: Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance
knowledge.text: 套管施工品質無法從外觀判斷，必須以試驗確認：拉拔試驗把圓形拉拔頭黏在硬化後的積層上、切穿至混凝土後垂直拉起，破壞面應在混凝土內，表示黏結強於基材；敲擊或紅外線熱影像可找出積層與混凝土之間的空鼓與脫層；見證試片則與現場同條件製作，送驗拉伸強度與彈性模數。這些結果與設計值比較，決定接受、修補或重做。
knowledge.textEn: Jacket quality cannot be judged by appearance and must be confirmed by tests: in a pull-off test a circular dolly is bonded to the cured laminate, cored through to the concrete and pulled perpendicular, and the failure surface should lie in the concrete, showing the bond is stronger than the substrate; tapping or infrared thermography finds voids and delaminations between laminate and concrete; witness panels made under site conditions are tested for tensile strength and modulus. Results are compared with design values to decide acceptance, repair or rework.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：纖維套管外觀平整沒有氣泡，就表示黏結良好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the jacket looks smooth with no bubbles, the bond must be good. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance" is correct?
options: 纖維套管外觀平整沒有氣泡，就表示黏結良好。
套管施工品質無法從外觀判斷，必須以試驗確認：拉拔試驗把圓形拉拔頭黏在硬化後的積層上、切穿至混凝土後垂直拉起，破壞面應在混凝土內，表示黏結強於基材。
只要有一篇試驗證明碳纖維有效，任何橋柱都能直接套用同一設計。
optionsEn: If the jacket looks smooth with no bubbles, the bond must be good.

Jacket quality cannot be judged by appearance and must be confirmed by tests: in a pull-off test a circular dolly is bonded to the cured laminate, cored through to the concrete and pulled perpendicular, and the failure surface should lie in the concrete, showing the bond is stronger than the substrate.
One test showing carbon fibre works means any column can use the same design.
quiz.explanation: 套管施工品質無法從外觀判斷，必須以試驗確認：拉拔試驗把圓形拉拔頭黏在硬化後的積層上、切穿至混凝土後垂直拉起，破壞面應在混凝土內，表示黏結強於基材；敲擊或紅外線熱影像可找出積層與混凝土之間的空鼓與脫層；見證試片則與現場同條件製作，送驗拉伸強度與彈性模數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Jacket quality cannot be judged by appearance and must be confirmed by tests: in a pull-off test a circular dolly is bonded to the cured laminate, cored through to the concrete and pulled perpendicular, and the failure surface should lie in the concrete, showing the bond is stronger than the substrate; tapping or infrared thermography finds voids and delaminations between laminate and concrete; witness panels made under site conditions are tested for tensile strength and modulus. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拉拔試驗與敲擊檢查」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pull-off and sounding tests” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：拉拔強度 σ = F/A。直徑 50 mm 拉拔頭面積 A = π×25² ≈ 1,963 mm²，破壞荷重 F = 2.8 kN，σ = 2,800/1,963 ≈ 1.43 MPa，且破壞面在混凝土內，達到常用的約 1.4 MPa 門檻；若破壞在樹脂界面且只有 0.9 MPa，判定黏結不良。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Pull-off strength σ = F/A. A 50 mm dolly has A = π×25² ≈ 1,963 mm²; a failure load F = 2.8 kN gives σ = 2,800/1,963 ≈ 1.43 MPa with failure in the concrete, meeting the common threshold of about 1.4 MPa; failure at the resin interface at only 0.9 MPa indicates poor bond. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依試驗標準決定拉拔試驗的頻率與位置（避開關鍵受力區或事後修補），記錄破壞模式；以敲擊或熱影像全面檢查，標示脫層位置與面積，依指引的容許值（例如單一小脫層面積與每平方公尺數量上限）判定，超出者以注射或局部切除重貼修補。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Set pull-off test frequency and locations per the test standard, avoiding critical zones or repairing them afterwards, and record the failure mode; survey the whole jacket by sounding or thermography, map delamination location and area, and judge against guidance limits such as maximum single-void size and count per square metre, repairing exceedances by injection or cut-out and re-lamination.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 拉拔強度 σ = F/A。直徑 50 mm 拉拔頭面積 A = π×25² ≈ 1,963 mm²，破壞荷重 F = 2.8 kN，σ = 2,800/1,963 ≈ 1.43 MPa，且破壞面在混凝土內，達到常用的約 1.4 MPa 門檻；若破壞在樹脂界面且只有 0.9 MPa，判定黏結不良。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Pull-off strength σ = F/A. A 50 mm dolly has A = π×25² ≈ 1,963 mm²; a failure load F = 2.8 kN gives σ = 2,800/1,963 ≈ 1.43 MPa with failure in the concrete, meeting the common threshold of about 1.4 MPa; failure at the resin interface at only 0.9 MPa indicates poor bond. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 套管表面沒有破裂，就代表裡面的混凝土也沒有損傷。
補強後橋墩越強越好，連基礎與帽梁的受力都不用重新檢查。
拉拔強度 σ = F/A。
optionsEn: If the jacket surface is not ruptured, the concrete inside is undamaged.
After retrofit the stronger the pier the better, with no need to recheck footing and cap-beam forces.
Pull-off strength σ = F/A.
quiz.explanation: 拉拔強度 σ = F/A。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Pull-off strength σ = F/A. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拉拔試驗與敲擊檢查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pull-off and sounding tests” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依試驗標準決定拉拔試驗的頻率與位置（避開關鍵受力區或事後修補），記錄破壞模式；以敲擊或熱影像全面檢查，標示脫層位置與面積，依指引的容許值（例如單一小脫層面積與每平方公尺數量上限）判定，超出者以注射或局部切除重貼修補。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Set pull-off test frequency and locations per the test standard, avoiding critical zones or repairing them afterwards, and record the failure mode; survey the whole jacket by sounding or thermography, map delamination location and area, and judge against guidance limits such as maximum single-void size and count per square metre, repairing exceedances by injection or cut-out and re-lamination. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.instructionEn: FRP retrofit formulas are credible because research laboratories tested near full-scale columns with old-style detailing under constant axial load, before and after retrofit: unretrofitted columns often failed in shear or by splice slip at small drift, while retrofitted ones developed stable flexural hysteresis and several times the displacement ductility. steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Before-and-after hysteresis comparison” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 引用試驗支持設計時，要比對試體的柱徑、軸力比、剪跨比、原有箍筋與搭接細節、纖維系統與層數是否與本案相近，並確認試驗包含反覆載重與足夠圈數；重要橋梁可要求以代表性柱做驗證試驗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: When citing tests in support of a design, compare specimen diameter, axial-load ratio, shear-span ratio, original hoop and splice details, fibre system and ply count with the project, and confirm the tests used reversed cyclic loading with enough cycles; important bridges can require a validation test on a representative column. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計報告附上所引用試驗的清單與適用性比較表，並說明本案與試驗的差異如何以保守係數處理；採用新纖維系統時，要求供應商提供針對橋柱的反覆載重試驗證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design report lists the cited tests with an applicability comparison table and explains how differences from the project are covered by conservative factors; for a new fibre system, require the supplier's cyclic test evidence on bridge columns.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以不同纖維系統或不同細節的試驗結果套用到本案，可能高估補強後的韌性；若試驗只做到中等漂移比就停止，無法證明套管在設計位移下不會斷裂或脫層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying test results from a different fibre system or different details can overestimate retrofitted ductility; tests stopped at moderate drift cannot show that the jacket will not rupture or debond at the design displacement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 大尺寸柱試驗與性能驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Large-scale column tests and performance validation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「補強前後遲滯比較」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Before-and-after hysteresis comparison” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以不同纖維系統或不同細節的試驗結果套用到本案，可能高估補強後的韌性；若試驗只做到中等漂移比就停止，無法證明套管在設計位移下不會斷裂或脫層。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying test results from a different fibre system or different details can overestimate retrofitted ductility; tests stopped at moderate drift cannot show that the jacket will not rupture or debond at the design displacement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試驗也揭示了限制：套管可能遮蔽損傷、端部間隙不當會改變塑鉸位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The tests also exposed limits: jackets can hide damage, and improper end gaps change where the hinge forms.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要有一篇試驗證明碳纖維有效，任何橋柱都能直接套用同一設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One test showing carbon fibre works means any column can use the same design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「紫外線、濕熱、撞擊與長期耐久」與「震後檢查、補強紀錄與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "UV, moisture, impact and long-term durability" and "Post-earthquake inspection, retrofit records and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 紫外線、濕熱、撞擊與長期耐久：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: UV, moisture, impact and long-term durability: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「面塗、防撞與耐久」如何影響橋墩纖維複材耐震補強的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Topcoat, impact protection and durability” governs force, deformation or durability in “FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 環氧樹脂暴露於紫外線會粉化，因此戶外套管需要面塗；長期濕熱與鹼性環境會降低樹脂與纖維界面的性能，玻璃纖維尤其敏感。橋墩位於河道或路旁時，還要面對漂流物、砂石磨耗與車輛撞擊，局部損傷會切斷環向纖維的連續性。碳纖維與鋼構件直接接觸可能引起電化學腐蝕，需以絕緣層隔開。賓州 I-84 跨越橋 1995 年完成的套管，在約 17 年後仍未見脫層，說明正確的材料選擇與保護可以提供長期性能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「面塗、防撞與耐久」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Epoxy chalks under UV, so exterior jackets need a topcoat; long-term moisture, heat and alkalinity degrade the resin–fibre interface, glass fibre especially. Piers in rivers or beside roads also face debris, sediment abrasion and vehicle impact, and local damage breaks the continuity of hoop fibres. Carbon fibre in direct contact with steel can cause galvanic corrosion and needs an insulating layer. The jackets placed on the Pennsylvania I-84 overpass in 1995 showed no delamination about 17 years later, showing that correct material choice and protection can deliver long-term performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Topcoat, impact protection and durability” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設計抗拉強度 f_fu = C_E·f*_fu：碳纖維 f*_fu = 3,800 MPa、戶外 C_E = 0.85，f_fu = 3,230 MPa；玻璃纖維 f*_fu = 1,520 MPa、C_E = 0.65，f_fu = 988 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Design tensile strength f_fu = C_E·f*_fu: carbon with f*_fu = 3,800 MPa and exterior C_E = 0.85 gives 3,230 MPa; glass with f*_fu = 1,520 MPa and C_E = 0.65 gives 988 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「纖維複材不會生鏽，因此包覆後的橋墩不需要任何維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "FRP does not rust, so a wrapped pier needs no maintenance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「面塗、防撞與耐久」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Topcoat, impact protection and durability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「紫外線、濕熱、撞擊與長期耐久」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "UV, moisture, impact and long-term durability" is correct?
options: 環氧樹脂暴露於紫外線會粉化，因此戶外套管需要面塗；長期濕熱與鹼性環境會降低樹脂與纖維界面的性能，玻璃纖維尤其敏感。

steps.title: 紫外線、濕熱、撞擊與長期耐久：定量估算
steps.titleEn: UV, moisture, impact and long-term durability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「面塗、防撞與耐久」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Topcoat, impact protection and durability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設計抗拉強度 f_fu = C_E·f*_fu：碳纖維 f*_fu = 3,800 MPa、戶外 C_E = 0.85，f_fu = 3,230 MPa；玻璃纖維 f*_fu = 1,520 MPa、C_E = 0.65，f_fu = 988 MPa。若河中墩撞擊切斷 6 層中的 2 層，局部圍束壓力降為 4/6 ≈ 67%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Design tensile strength f_fu = C_E·f*_fu: carbon with f*_fu = 3,800 MPa and exterior C_E = 0.85 gives 3,230 MPa; glass with f*_fu = 1,520 MPa and C_E = 0.65 gives 988 MPa. If impact on an in-river pier severs 2 of 6 plies, local confining pressure falls to 4/6 ≈ 67%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期檢查面塗粉化、裂紋、褪色、纖維外露、撞擊痕、底部積水與鏽水；以敲擊或熱影像比對交接時的基準圖，追蹤脫層是否擴大，並在撞擊後量測受損範圍與斷層數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect periodically for topcoat chalking, cracking, fading, exposed fibres, impact marks, water trapped at the base and rust staining; compare sounding or thermography with the handover baseline map to track growth of delamination, and after impact measure the damaged extent and number of severed plies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 設計抗拉強度 f_fu = C_E·f*_fu：碳纖維 f*_fu = 3,800 MPa、戶外 C_E = 0.85，f_fu = 3,230 MPa；玻璃纖維 f*_fu = 1,520 MPa、C_E = 0.65，f_fu = 988 MPa。若河中墩撞擊切斷 6 層中的 2 層，局部圍束壓力降為 4/6 ≈ 67%。數值為教學假設。

If impact on an in-river pier severs 2 of 6 plies, local confining pressure falls to 4/6 ≈ 67%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「紫外線、濕熱、撞擊與長期耐久」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "UV, moisture, impact and long-term durability", which statement holds?
options: 補強後橋墩越強越好，連基礎與帽梁的受力都不用重新檢查。
設計抗拉強度 f_fu = C_E·f*_fu：碳纖維 f*_fu = 3,800 MPa、戶外 C_E = 0.85，f_fu = 3,230 MPa。
纖維層數加倍，圍束與剪力效果一定也加倍，且不受柱徑影響。
optionsEn: After retrofit the stronger the pier the better, with no need to recheck footing and cap-beam forces.
Design tensile strength f_fu = C_E·f*_fu: carbon with f*_fu = 3,800 MPa and exterior C_E = 0.85 gives 3,230 MPa.
Doubling the plies always doubles confinement and shear benefit, regardless of column diameter.
quiz.explanation: 設計抗拉強度 f_fu = C_E·f*_fu：碳纖維 f*_fu = 3,800 MPa、戶外 C_E = 0.85，f_fu = 3,230 MPa；玻璃纖維 f*_fu = 1,520 MPa、C_E = 0.65，f_fu = 988 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.titleEn: UV, moisture, impact and long-term durability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「面塗、防撞與耐久」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Topcoat, impact protection and durability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期檢查面塗粉化、裂紋、褪色、纖維外露、撞擊痕、底部積水與鏽水；以敲擊或熱影像比對交接時的基準圖，追蹤脫層是否擴大，並在撞擊後量測受損範圍與斷層數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：未做面塗的套管數年後樹脂粉化、纖維外露，濕氣沿裂紋侵入；套管底部若密封不當，雨水積在套管與混凝土之間無法排出，混凝土與鋼筋在套管內持續劣化卻無法被看見。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a topcoat, the resin chalks and fibres become exposed within a few years, letting moisture in along cracks; a poorly sealed jacket base traps rainwater between jacket and concrete, so concrete and reinforcement keep deteriorating inside the jacket unseen. steps.title: 紫外線、濕熱、撞擊與長期耐久：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: UV, moisture, impact and long-term durability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「面塗、防撞與耐久」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Topcoat, impact protection and durability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未做面塗的套管數年後樹脂粉化、纖維外露，濕氣沿裂紋侵入；套管底部若密封不當，雨水積在套管與混凝土之間無法排出，混凝土與鋼筋在套管內持續劣化卻無法被看見。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a topcoat, the resin chalks and fibres become exposed within a few years, letting moisture in along cracks; a poorly sealed jacket base traps rainwater between jacket and concrete, so concrete and reinforcement keep deteriorating inside the jacket unseen. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：賓州 I-84 跨越橋 1995 年完成的套管，在約 17 年後仍未見脫層，說明正確的材料選擇與保護可以提供長期性能。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The jackets placed on the Pennsylvania I-84 overpass in 1995 showed no delamination about 17 years later, showing that correct material choice and protection can deliver long-term performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「纖維複材不會生鏽，因此包覆後的橋墩不需要任何維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "FRP does not rust, so a wrapped pier needs no maintenance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「紫外線、濕熱、撞擊與長期耐久」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "UV, moisture, impact and long-term durability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 未做面塗的套管數年後樹脂粉化、纖維外露，濕氣沿裂紋侵入；套管底部若密封不當，雨水積在套管與混凝土之間無法排出，混凝土與鋼筋在套管內持續劣化卻無法被看見。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
套管表面沒有破裂，就代表裡面的混凝土也沒有損傷。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

steps.title: 震後檢查、補強紀錄與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake inspection, retrofit records and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「套管周長量測」如何影響橋墩纖維複材耐震補強的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jacket circumference measurement” governs force, deformation or durability in “FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 套管把混凝土包起來，也把地震損傷藏起來：震後檢查員無法直接看到裂縫與剝落，只能從套管的鼓脹、皺褶、纖維斷裂、樹脂白化與底部碎屑判斷。量測套管周長變化是簡單有效的方法，因為核心混凝土膨脹會使套管環向伸長，換算的環向應變可與設計有效應變比較。因此交接時要留下每支柱的周長、厚度、熱影像基準與試驗結果，震後才能比較；判斷結果決定繼續使用、加層補強或拆除重做。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「套管周長量測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A jacket encloses the concrete and also hides earthquake damage: inspectors cannot see cracks and spalling directly and must read jacket bulging, wrinkles, broken fibres, resin whitening and debris at the base. Measuring the change in jacket circumference is simple and effective, because core dilation stretches the jacket in the hoop direction and the resulting hoop strain can be compared with the design effective strain. Handover must therefore record each column's circumference, thickness, thermography baseline and test results so post-earthquake comparison is possible; the judgement decides continued use, added plies or removal and rework. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Jacket circumference measurement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：環向應變 ε = ΔC/C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Hoop strain ε = ΔC/C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「套管表面沒有破裂，就代表裡面的混凝土也沒有損傷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the jacket surface is not ruptured, the concrete inside is undamaged." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「套管周長量測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Jacket circumference measurement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 震後檢查、補強紀錄與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Post-earthquake inspection, retrofit records and handover
knowledge.text: 套管把混凝土包起來，也把地震損傷藏起來：震後檢查員無法直接看到裂縫與剝落，只能從套管的鼓脹、皺褶、纖維斷裂、樹脂白化與底部碎屑判斷。量測套管周長變化是簡單有效的方法，因為核心混凝土膨脹會使套管環向伸長，換算的環向應變可與設計有效應變比較。

quiz.question: 關於「震後檢查、補強紀錄與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-earthquake inspection, retrofit records and handover" is correct?

steps.title: 震後檢查、補強紀錄與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake inspection, retrofit records and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「套管周長量測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Jacket circumference measurement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：環向應變 ε = ΔC/C。D = 1.5 m 柱周長 C ≈ 4,712 mm，震後以周長尺量得增加 20 mm，ε = 20/4,712 ≈ 0.0042，約為設計有效應變 0.0079 的 53%，套管仍在作用，但已超過剪力計算常用的 0.004 上限，表示核心可能已明顯膨脹，需進一步檢查。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Hoop strain ε = ΔC/C. A D = 1.5 m column has C ≈ 4,712 mm; if a circumference tape shows a 20 mm increase after an earthquake, ε = 20/4,712 ≈ 0.0042, about 53% of the 0.0079 design effective strain, so the jacket is still working, but above the 0.004 limit often used for shear, indicating significant core dilation that needs further investigation. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：震後依程序量測每支補強柱在塑鉸區的周長、殘留傾斜與套管外觀，以熱影像比對基準，必要時局部開窗檢查核心；結果與交接基準比較後，由結構工程師簽認是否恢復通行。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After an earthquake measure each retrofitted column's hinge-zone circumference, residual tilt and jacket condition by procedure, compare thermography with the baseline and open inspection windows into the core where needed; after comparison with handover baselines a structural engineer signs off on reopening.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

A D = 1.5 m column has C ≈ 4,712 mm; if a circumference tape shows a 20 mm increase after an earthquake, ε = 20/4,712 ≈ 0.0042, about 53% of the 0.0079 design effective strain, so the jacket is still working, but above the 0.004 limit often used for shear, indicating significant core dilation that needs further investigation. knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 震後檢查、補強紀錄與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake inspection, retrofit records and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「套管周長量測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Jacket circumference measurement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 震後依程序量測每支補強柱在塑鉸區的周長、殘留傾斜與套管外觀，以熱影像比對基準，必要時局部開窗檢查核心；結果與交接基準比較後，由結構工程師簽認是否恢復通行。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After an earthquake measure each retrofitted column's hinge-zone circumference, residual tilt and jacket condition by procedure, compare thermography with the baseline and open inspection windows into the core where needed; after comparison with handover baselines a structural engineer signs off on reopening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含補強設計計算、纖維系統與批號、層數與範圍竣工圖、環境與施工紀錄、拉拔與試片報告、熱影像與周長基準及震後檢查程序；恢復通行由主管機關指定的結構工程師簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover includes retrofit calculations, fibre system and batch numbers, as-built ply and extent drawings, environmental and construction records, pull-off and panel reports, thermography and circumference baselines and the post-earthquake procedure; reopening is signed off by a structural engineer designated by the owner agency.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交接時沒有記錄套管周長與熱影像基準，震後無法判斷變化是否來自地震；管理單位只看套管沒有破裂就恢復通行，實際核心可能已壓碎、主筋挫屈，餘震中軸向承載不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without recorded circumference and thermography baselines at handover, post-earthquake changes cannot be attributed to the earthquake; an owner who reopens because the jacket did not rupture may miss a crushed core and buckled bars inside, leaving inadequate axial capacity in aftershocks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

options: 震後依程序量測每支補強柱在塑鉸區的周長、殘留傾斜與套管外觀，以熱影像比對基準，必要時局部開窗檢查核心；結果與交接基準比較後，由結構工程師簽認是否恢復通行。

quiz.explanationEn: After an earthquake measure each retrofitted column's hinge-zone circumference, residual tilt and jacket condition by procedure, compare thermography with the baseline and open inspection windows into the core where needed; after comparison with handover baselines a structural engineer signs off on reopening. steps.title: 震後檢查、補強紀錄與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake inspection, retrofit records and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「套管周長量測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Jacket circumference measurement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交接時沒有記錄套管周長與熱影像基準，震後無法判斷變化是否來自地震；管理單位只看套管沒有破裂就恢復通行，實際核心可能已壓碎、主筋挫屈，餘震中軸向承載不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without recorded circumference and thermography baselines at handover, post-earthquake changes cannot be attributed to the earthquake; an owner who reopens because the jacket did not rupture may miss a crushed core and buckled bars inside, leaving inadequate axial capacity in aftershocks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此交接時要留下每支柱的周長、厚度、熱影像基準與試驗結果，震後才能比較；判斷結果決定繼續使用、加層補強或拆除重做。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover must therefore record each column's circumference, thickness, thermography baseline and test results so post-earthquake comparison is possible; the judgement decides continued use, added plies or removal and rework.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「套管表面沒有破裂，就代表裡面的混凝土也沒有損傷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the jacket surface is not ruptured, the concrete inside is undamaged." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
